thread.title: These Dow and S&P 500 stocks took the biggest hits on fears of a Trump trade war - MarketWatch

author: Philip van Doorn
title: These Dow and S&P 500 stocks took the biggest hits on fears of a Trump trade war - MarketWatch
text:
Shares of large U.S. companies were hit hard Thursday after President Trump announced new tariffs on steel and aluminum.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average tumbled 420 points, or 1.7%, although it was down as much as 2.3% during the trading session. The S&P 500 Index fell 36 points, or 1.3%.
Read: President tells steel, aluminum executives they’ll have ‘protection’ as he announces tariffs
More on trade: Steel tariffs to hit these eight countries the hardest (China is not one of them)
